_comment: Fragment 66 — D-111: the schema window closes except the risk-tier residual. Merged 2026-08-25.

nodes.label: D-111 — The Schema Window Closes Except One Residual
nodes.description: The transition-control column name, the report record shape, template applicability and retraction behaviour are settled. The risk dimension is settled in shape only.
nodes.rationale: Recording the risk dimension as closed on a shape-only ruling would be the defect the previous decision had just finished correcting: a settled-looking row hiding an open question.

nodes.label: The Column Names What the System Can Prove
nodes.description: The transition-control column takes the name describing structural line separation rather than the one describing independence of judgment.
nodes.rationale: The code only ever writes a structural fact, and the table is append-only, so a name asserting a cognitive fact would have been permanently wrong. This closes the original defect rather than renaming around it.

nodes.label: Applicability Is Anchored on When the Work Started, Not When the Report Was Generated
nodes.description: Report template versions are successive and auditable, each declaring the fields it requires, and none may be applied backward. The anchor is the originating article record creation time.
nodes.rationale: The question a later reader must answer is whether these fields were required when the work happened. A generation date answers only when someone pressed the button, and drifts freely from the work; the flow chronology stays true when a report is regenerated.

nodes.label: A Retraction Creates Evidence Rather Than Removing It
nodes.description: A retraction never detaches an issued report. The linkage runs through the originating article record and exists for auditability.
nodes.rationale: Retraction is precisely the event that makes the prior record matter most, so severing the link at that moment would destroy the evidence at the point of maximum need.

nodes.label: The Brief Is the Originating Record, Not a New Table
nodes.description: The briefcase is defined as an operating label and explicitly not a database table or authorization to implement storage, while a separate decision describes both flows as two exposures of one editorial brief.
nodes.rationale: Read the other way the migration would have authorised storage the board proposal withholds. Resolving it to the existing originating row means no new table and no amendment.

nodes.label: A Typed Column With an Undefined Domain Is a Text Field With a Hopeful Name
nodes.description: The risk dimension is approved as typed, never a lifecycle state, and never silently recomputed. Its vocabulary, assignment authority, proposal mechanism and provenance remain undecided.
nodes.rationale: The dependent control for pre-publication legal review cannot trigger without a vocabulary to trigger on, so the migration stays unauthorised until the domain is settled.
